title: Unit conversion of the actual ordered affine counit mate
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], Y a Noetherian scheme, N=P.diagonalExponent invertible on Y, d a natural number, t a normalized ordinary finite twist transport and D its family of normalized projective-line data. Put p=affineTraceProjection Y d. Let c be affineLinearCoefficientDescent followed by vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback along p [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action]. Then the actual affine counit mate [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data], followed by inverse unitChange [def-pur-diagonal-counit-comparison-data], is c inverse followed by CoordinateCounitArrows.towerAdjoint [def-trf-coordinate-counit-arrows]. The counit and all coefficient comparisons are the prescribed constructions; no new choice or compatibility assumption is introduced.

source.place: Agreement on the model: the ordered affine integration and its exceptional-adjunction transpose; conversion between coefficient-unit and monoidal-unit presentations.

proof.text: Expand diagonalAffineMate, unitChange and towerAdjoint. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right to the exceptional adjunction, postcomposing with singleFunctorObjUnitIso.hom, and precompose with the inverse ordered coefficient-descent isomorphism. Associativity identifies the counit composites. This purely categorical identity includes d=0, empty schemes and zero coefficient rings.

theorem affineCounitMate_unitChange (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hY : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    P.diagonalAffineMate t D Y hY d ≫
        (OrientationCounit.unitChange P (affineTraceProjection Y d)).inv =
      ((Etale.affineLinearCoefficientDescent P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t Y hY d) ≪≫
        Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t (affineTraceProjection Y d) hY d).inv ≫
        Etale.CoordinateCounitArrows.towerAdjoint P.diagonalExponent
          (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t D Y hY d
